top_concerns: Over‑estimation of resistant hypertension without evidence of ≥3 agents
Under‑estimation of OSA and NAFLD probabilities
Absence of explicit prediabetes and obesity/metabolic‑syndrome diagnoses
Lack of FH‑specific data (family history, xanthomas, genetics)
recommended_primary: Familial Hypercholesterolemia (possible heterozygous FH) as the leading driver of severe hyperlipidaemia
review_summary: The Diagnostic Agent captured the major high‑risk problems but mis‑calibrated several probabilities and omitted key stand‑alone diagnoses (prediabetes, obesity/metabolic‑syndrome). Adjusted probabilities now sum to 1.0 and better reflect the evidence. Recommendations focus on confirming FH, intensifying antihypertensive therapy, addressing opioid risk, and completing work‑up for OSA, CKD, NAFLD, and mental health.
